<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Purpose

Avoid repeating Mooncake block grouping for aligned regions with identical
request-local block selections. Cache grouped IDs only after a region's sender
plan chooses to transfer; addresses, lengths, TP offsets and coalescing remain
region-specific. NULL filtering and logical-to-physical expansion are unchanged.

The cache key is `(group_index, shared_group_ids)`: packed allocations can use
the same shared-group sentinel but select different groups or orders. The cache
is reset for each request, not shared across requests.

This is distinct from #53078/#55097 and #53237, which address heterogeneous-TP
correctness, NULL alignment or descriptor granularity rather than repeated
grouping. The current base still groups each region independently. No public
API, configuration or model change.

## Test Plan

```bash
ruff check vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/mooncake/mooncake_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector{,_hybrid_mamba}.py
ruff format --check vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/mooncake/mooncake_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector{,_hybrid_mamba}.py
pytest -q tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector{,_hybrid_mamba}.py
git diff HEAD^ HEAD --check
```

## Test Result

Current rebase: base `df8fd4211`, head
`f7732ebdb9d93a9e727c97632de9c593cfcb63e8`.

- Preserved upstream packed-cache/bootstrap tests and resolved the helper
  insertion conflict. Adapted the cache key to the new shared-group selection
  contract; a regression checks repeated ordinary groups and different shared
  selections/orders without reusing another selection's descriptors.
- Focused planner/cache portfolio: **51 passed** in 27.66 s.
- Complete two-file CPU suite: **123 passed** in 81.45 s, including the new
  shared-selection regression. This was an **adapted CPU contract check**, not
  exact native/accelerator qualification: source imported from a read-only mount
  in a cached, nonexact vLLM CI image; network/GPU disabled; offline OPT-125M
  config; process-local CPU device-index and block-size adaptations. The run had
  17 warnings, including uninitialized TP-group destructors and unawaited sender
  coroutines. Do not interpret this as a strict warning-free suite pass.
- Ruff **0.14.0** (repository-pinned version), check/format and diff-check pass.

Earlier validation of head `42af250` included 44 paired descriptor-parity
observations and a reduced-scope RTX4060/native Mooncake unit run. These remain
**prior-head evidence**, not native or performance validation of this rebase.

Pending: upstream CI, exact supported-accelerator/native Mooncake checks,
representative serving/model correctness and paired real-workload performance.
There is no E2E latency, throughput, model-accuracy, RDMA or cross-hardware claim.

OpenAI Codex assisted the implementation and this update. Existing human
ownership remains; the newly rebased diff and shared-group adaptation are
available for the submitter's re-review. This update does not claim a new human
line review or native test execution.

---

- [x] Public API/configuration unchanged; no user documentation change needed.
- [x] Git/DCO identity and AI assistance recorded.
- [ ] Human re-review of the newly rebased diff complete.
- [ ] Upstream CI and native/real-workload qualification complete.

</details>
